_about: Which model does each job, in the order they are tried. No secrets here: keys come only from env vars
(GEMINI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for provider claude, OPENAI_API_KEY for provider openai, TYPESAFE_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY / CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, chosen by JEV_PROVIDER).
Override any role locally in config/models.local.json (gitignored); a role there replaces the role here.
Jev only answers judge roles. With JEV_PROVIDER=openrouter or cloudflare the Jev model gets a 'typesafe/' prefix;
Cloudflare users may need "typesafe/jev" in models.local.json.
kind: json (structured answer), text (streamed prose), search (web-grounded answer), judge (typed judgment).
when: a role is only needed sometimes: jev (Jev is on), research_live (RESEARCH_LIVE=true), startup (the startup check).
The setup screen (Models button) edits config/models.local.json; this file stays the committed default.
prices (optional): {"provider/model": {"input_per_mtok": USD, "output_per_mtok": USD}} for the AI reader's cost check (MAX_RUN_COST_USD). Unknown prices are left out, never guessed.
An entry can be a list of dated prices ({"from": "YYYY-MM-DD", ...}); the latest one in effect today applies.

The Gemini prices are the paid tier's Standard text prices per 1M tokens (output includes thinking), from https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, read 2026-09-27. On the free tier the real cost is $0, so the check is an upper bound.

The Claude prices are Anthropic's first-party API list prices per 1M tokens (output includes thinking), read 2026-06-24. OpenAI prices aren't listed yet: add them here from openai.com/api/pricing before relying on the cost check.

extract_fallback.label: Read hard filing pages
extract_fallback.description: Reads a Dominion filing page that the regular parser couldn't make sense of, and copies out the project on it.

extract_submission.label: Read added plans
extract_submission.description: Reads PDFs and web pages you add in the Sources menu, page by page, and copies out each project.

reader.label: Read filings without a parser
reader.description: Finds the pages of an added filing that list projects, then copies each project out with the page and exact text every value came from.

endpoint_split.label: Split project names
endpoint_split.description: Finds the two places in an awkward project name, like 'Canadys - Church Creek Tap', so each end can be found on the map.

confirm_osm.label: Confirm substations
confirm_osm.description: Decides whether a substation found on OpenStreetMap is really the one the filing names.

confirm_town.label: Confirm towns
confirm_town.description: Decides whether a town is a fair stand-in for a place the filing names, when no substation was found.

confirm_place.label: Confirm other places
confirm_place.description: Decides whether a place found by name search fits the project, as a last resort.

classify_type.label: Sort projects by kind of work
classify_type.description: Tags each project as a new line, a rebuild, substation construction or equipment work.

validate_semantic.label: Spot copied text
validate_semantic.description: Flags a project whose stated need talks about different work than its description, a sign of text copied from another project.

research_confirm.label: Confirm other utilities' places
research_confirm.description: Decides whether a place found on the map is the one a research record about another utility names.

research_search.label: Search the web
research_search.description: Searches the web for other utilities' construction projects near the river.

research_extract.label: Turn search results into records
research_extract.description: Turns what the web search found into project records, each tied to the pages it came from.

cost_search.label: Look up project costs
cost_search.description: Searches the web for a published cost of each paired project whose filing doesn't state one.

cost_extract.label: Read the cost found
cost_extract.description: Pulls the one dollar figure, its quote and its page out of what the cost search found.

cost_quote_check.label: Check cost quotes
cost_quote_check.description: Decides whether a quoted cost is really this project's own cost, and whether the amount matches the quote.

savings_check.label: Check sharing is worth raising
savings_check.description: Decides whether sharing what a pair's distance tier allows is worth raising between the two utilities.

analyst.label: Write up opportunities
analyst.description: Writes a short paragraph about each top pair of nearby projects, using only the facts it's given.

advocate.label: Prepare each utility's side
advocate.description: Drafts what each utility would want from a coordination meeting about a pair.

mediator.label: Draft the joint agenda
mediator.description: Drafts a neutral agenda item from both sides' notes.

writer.label: Write the report
writer.description: Writes the summary and next steps of the final report. Every number in it comes from the pipeline, not the model.

watchdog.label: Watch for stuck agents
watchdog.description: Checks every few seconds whether a running agent has stopped making progress.

smoke.label: Check at startup
smoke.description: Makes one tiny call when the server starts, to show whether Gemini is reachable.
